mostWorthwhile.text: Linking bone cells to a blood supply was most worthwhile: the planned cutaway shows how nutrients reach embedded osteocytes while blood cells remain in the vessel, making bone's living nature concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the supplied cells to the framework repeated much of the preceding nutrient-channel picture, so it felt less informative than establishing the blood supply.

surprise.text: The distinction between vessels and the tiny fluid-filled channels reaching osteocytes sharpened my understanding of how embedded bone cells are supplied.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though combining bone cells directly with blood vessels was an abstract construction rather than a literal account of how mature bone develops.

continue.text: I would continue: assembling the elbow connected the separate tissue details to movement and restraint, and I would be curious to see how muscles act on it.
